title: THE CANNIBAL ISLE // SKAGOSIAN UNICORNS
narrative: Davos lands his skiff upon the volcanic beaches of Skagos under a sky of bruised purple clouds. In the high mountain crags, wild men ride shaggy four-legged beasts with great spiraling horns like ivory spears. In a deep obsidian cavern, a wild eight-year-old boy with unkempt black hair gnaws on smoked goat meat beside a monstrous black direwolf whose eyes burn like green wildfire.

options.text: Bring Rickon Stark and Shaggydog back to White Harbor.
Bargain with the Magnar of Skagos for an alliance of stone men.
